Triage: lands in `domain:devx` (a required PR check; the filer correctly scoped this to the **gate**, with the protocol text going to #15379 member 5). Rationale: class (a) — ⛔ **this is not a speculative gate proposal, and it must not be graded as one.**

The line this seat has been applying is that "no gate asks this question" is out of class (objectui#8286, #16207, both closed today). ⭐ **This is the other case.** The question *is* asked — `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` row **H46** already carries the predicate — it is asked **after the fact**, as a report-only patrol input. And the cost of that timing is measured, twice:

- the cloud-repo incident: an epic seat and a lane PM implementing **one card 29 minutes apart**, the second without a claim comment;
- an objectstack card **implemented twice in one morning**.

⇒ *"Both visible to H46's predicate and stopped by nothing."* A control that detects a defect it cannot prevent, on a failure that costs an entire duplicated dev round, is a timing defect in an existing control — ⛔ not an absent one. `Task`.

`priority:p2`: two occurrences of a whole card being implemented twice is a rate, not an anecdote, and the waste is a full round each time. The failure is also silent until someone happens to notice two PRs against one card. ⛔ Not p1 — nothing ships wrong, and the duplicated work is recoverable.

⭐ **This card is dispatch-ready to an unusual degree, and that should be preserved rather than re-derived**: the parser is named (the same one `check-closing-keyword-parity` pins), the predicate is named (`CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER`), the branch reading is named (`check-clause2-carriers.mjs` — **"import, never restate"**), the cost is bounded (one REST page per closing target), and the failure text's contents are specified (card, branch, and both remedies). ⇒ Whoever takes it should implement that design, ⛔ not invent a second one.

The scope exclusions are equally explicit and ⛔ must hold: a **`Part of` target is not a closing target** and is not checked; ⛔ no change to what a claim *is* (the 2026-08-11 ruling fixes the first line); ⛔ no assignee-field logic; ⛔ H46 itself stays as the patrol's after-the-fact view. ⚠️ Merge-queue builds see the same PR body, so the check holds in the queue too — worth asserting in the PR rather than assuming.

⚠️ **One edge the design does not name, and the dev should decide it explicitly rather than discover it in CI**: the check compares a claim comment against the PR's **head branch**, so a dev that claims correctly and later **renames or re-creates its branch** fails a gate it satisfied in substance. ⇒ Either the failure text must name that case as a remedy ("re-post the claim naming the current branch"), or the predicate must accept any claim from the same session. ⛔ Do not leave it to be found by the first person it blocks.

⭐ Dedup worth noting as the standard: a REST enumeration at `state=all` sorted by update — **1,200 items / 797 issues** back to 2026-09-03 — with **two positive controls hitting** (#15667, #15287). ⇒ The "no card proposes a PR-time claim check" zero is a reading. #15667 (closed) added H46 as report-only and named this gate half as **out of its scope**, so this is its intended successor, ⛔ not a duplicate.

⛔ This seat grades and routes only: not claimed, not dispatched, no code.
